                    Dear Jeffrey,
                    I wanted to update you on our placebo initiative at Harvard. I've
                    been asked to start a Harvard-wide Program in Placebo Studies
                    which will be hosted at the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center.
                    It will do basic, clinical and social science research as well as
                    scholarly work in placebo studies. We arc situated in all the major
                    teaching hospitals at Harvard and have already drawn commitments




                                                                                          EFTA_R1_00248269
                                                                                             EFTA01852991
              from over 20 faculty. Anne Harrington will be joining us. We
             recently published an physiological study of placebo in the New
             England Journal of Medicine and a theoretical paper in Philosophic
             Transactions of the Roy Soc B. (I'm attaching fyi). We anticipate
             making some major breakthroughs in genetic ofplacebo effects
             (we're submitting our findings in the next days) and have major
             studies in the pipeline. We're hoping that this program will establish
             Placebo Studies as a important component of medical research
             internationally. Here is our new website:
              www.programinplacebostudies.org. Let me know if this is of any
             interest for you.

Sincerely,

Ted


             Ted J. Kaptchuk
